Examples.Title: Add memories (V3)
Examples.Description: Extract and store memories from a conversation using the V3 additive pipeline. Entity IDs (`user_id` / `agent_id` / `run_id`) are accepted at the top level. At least one entity ID is required so the memory is scoped to a session.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Mem0;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Get all memories (V3, paginated)
Examples.Description: List memories scoped by filters, paginated. Entity IDs **must** be passed inside the `filters` object. Top-level `user_id` / `agent_id` / `run_id` are rejected with 400. `filters` supports the same operator set as V2 search (`AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `in`, `gte`, `lte`, etc.). Response is a paginated envelope; pass `page` and `page_size` as query parameters to step through results.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Mem0;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Search memories (V3)
Examples.Description: Relevance-ranked search across stored memories. V3 uses hybrid retrieval and can also apply temporal reasoning for time-aware queries. Entity IDs **must** be passed inside the `filters` object. Top-level `user_id` / `agent_id` / `run_id` are rejected with 400. At least one entity ID is required.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Mem0;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create Webhook
Examples.Description: Create a new webhook for a specific project
Examples.Code:
### Create Webhook
# @name create_webhook
POST {{host}}/api/v1/webhooks/projects/{{project_id}}/
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "event_types": [
    "memory_add"
  ],
  "is_active": true,
  "project_id": "string"
}

## Responses
# 201
# Description: Webhook created successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid request
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Unauthorized access
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Update Webhook
Examples.Code:
### Update Webhook
# @name update_webhook
PUT {{host}}/api/v1/webhooks/{{webhook_id}}/
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "event_types": [
    "memory_add"
  ]
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Webhook updated successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid request
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Unauthorized access
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Webhook not found
# Content-Type: application/json
